text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. I had been working silently in 
the Trainer's Office, but my concentration 
was running out...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. Oh, Trainer, are you feeling 
worn out, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Working yourself into the ground isn't 
good either, you know? At times like 
this—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A present of dried squid from the 
shopping street!
choice_data_list:
"Delicious Delicacies Contest: 3rd Place 
for 3 Consecutive Years"...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep. "Bronze Collector." I kinda felt a 
sense of kinship with it. And when I 
bought some, it was crazy delicious!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The more you chew, the more flavor comes 
out. It's a special recommendation of 
mine~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right? Like how you can't quite reach 
certain spots—
choice_data_list:
She's an Umamusume who grows on you the 
more you get to know her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's what you're going with? 
Flattery won't get you anything more than 
dried squid, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, don't worry about me, let's take a 
break, okay? Here, eat some dried squid, 
eat up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I ate the dried squid with Nice 
Nature, and just as she had said, its 
flavor was truly addictive.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And here's another present: some 
dried squid I bought at the shopping 
district~.
choice_data_list:
It's that delicious dried squid from the 
other day!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oho, glad to hear it went well. Though 
that's not all we're doing today~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Dipping the dried squid into mayonnaise 
mixed with shichimi chili powder—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right? Just adding a little twist makes it 
so many times better~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right then, inspiration struck!
choice_data_list:
(I should add a little twist to Nature's 
menu too...!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did inspiration just strike you? I'm 
rooting for you, but don't push yourself 
too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—savoring the sweet and spicy 
blend of flavors, I worked on refining the 
training menu.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And here's another present: some 
dried squid I bought at the shopping 
district~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Since this year's "Delicious Delicacies 
Contest" is coming up, they want feedback 
from their best customers~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They say chewing on dried squid gets the 
brain gears turning. Care to join me for a 
quick break?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—perhaps thanks to the dried 
squid, both my desk work and her training 
yielded great results.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How about some delicious dried squid that 
won 1st place in the "Gourmet Delicacies 
Contest"?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The uncle at the dried goods store was 
crying tears of joy~ It somehow ended up 
making me super happy too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They said this was to share the 
celebration of getting 1st place. Jeez, 
and after I told them I'd properly pay for 
it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And with that, why don't we take a quick 
break? Thinking so hard makes you hungry, 
right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's have a celebration party!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—savoring the flavor of the dried 
squid, the two of us relished the joy 
together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A present of dried squid from the 
shopping street!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep. The more you chew, the more flavor 
comes out. It's my top-tier special 
recommendation~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I've gotta work hard too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing. Let's eat some dried 
squid together, Trainer!
